Breath of Fire III is an RPG made by Capcom for PlayStation. This is the second RPG I've ever played and have the least modification during my playthrough. Of all the Breath of Fire I've played (being III, IV and V), I like this one most due to the custom dragon system and the storyline.

Miscellaneous Codes

Description Gameshark Type Remark
Money 90144F50 4 byte
Form Party Flag 30143F02 1 byte Setting this to 01 will allow changing party member via the submenu. Setting this to 00 will disallow changing party member
Encounter 80143F22 2 byte Increases on every step you take. The higher the value, the more likely an encounter happen. Freeze this at 0 to completely disable encounter.
Text Speed 80144950 2 byte
Battle Counter 8014502C 2 byte
Fishing Cast Power 801440BC 2 byte
Ship Engine 80145E9A 2 byte

Description Gameshark Type Remark

Doraemon

[[[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doraemon | Doraemon]]] is a robotic cat featured in a Manga created by Fujiko Fujio. The cat made an appearance in the game anytime you use an Accession skill.
